prompt: A nine-person scheduling startup has six multi-site dental groups paying for pilots. Founder-led outreach and onboarding produced all six. At the pilot sites, 70% of invited office managers start setup, 35% complete the practice-management integration, and 22% still schedule through the product in week eight. The two retained groups refer peers and praise the support, but the four others report integration delays and confusing setup. A reseller offers access to 400 dental groups if the startup commits to a trade-show launch and reseller campaign next month; price and reseller economics are not settled. Procurement and integration take six to eight weeks. The CEO wants to accept, hire three salespeople, and optimize demos. Give a 60-day acquisition, activation, retention, and ownership plan.
